body:
Well, out of fear from past legal issues a few years back, and high costs I  decided to try this stuff out to ease my menstrual cramps.I was pretty certain that it wouldn't help my insane (and I really mean insane) cramping.
My boyfriend drove me to get, since I had felt pretty lousy our whole day we got to spend together.  However we got back and I had 3 separate hits within 15 minutes of each one. It did help the menstrual pain  and it caused a reasonably comparable high. Concepts discussed seemed funny at times, some abstract, but almost sensible thought flow. I could concentrate on a book I had to read. I felt a little fuzzy so to speak, as if I was pretty high one actual weed, but too fuzzy like I had smoked res. I noticed that it wore off quickly and it certainly felt different but not in anyway I can describe.
I think I'd use it now and again, but I'd like to find out more about the chemical compound. I do like the idea that it is a legal high though, but first and foremost actual cannabis needs to be decriminalzed/legalized, just in case this isn't the most safe chemical compound when used on a regular basis.
